marketing_claims.text_ru: Вместе с партией и ПСБ запустили военный маркетплейс «Роймаркет». Платформа протестирована.
marketing_claims.text_en: Together with the party and ПСБ we launched the military marketplace «Roymarket». The platform has been tested.
marketing_claims.context: Александр Сидякин (руководитель Центрального исполкома «Единой России»), @asidyakin post 618, 15.12.2025, on the ЦБСТ board meeting. Names «партия» (Единая Россия) and ПСБ as co-launchers; МПТМ is not named in the post.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Пилотный запуск подтвердил реальный спрос: к платформе присоединились десятки потребителей, а каталог вырос до нескольких сотен позиций.
marketing_claims.text_en: The pilot launch confirmed real demand: dozens of consumers joined the platform and the catalogue grew to several hundred items.
marketing_claims.context: Сидякин, @asidyakin post 1230, 05.08.2026, summarising the ЦБСТ Наблюдательный совет. Self-reported figures.

marketing_claims.text_ru: К 1 сентября к платформе планируется подключить все технико-эксплуатационные части (ТЭЧ) Минобороны РФ.
marketing_claims.text_en: By 1 September all technical-operations units (ТЭЧ) of the Ministry of Defence are planned to be connected to the platform.
marketing_claims.context: ЦБСТ's own channel, post 2392, 06.08.2026, citing Безруков's comment to Коммерсантъ. A plan, not a reported fact.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Центр беспилотных систем и технологий (ЦБСТ) выводит маркетплейс товаров двойного назначения «Рой.Маркет» из пилотного режима и начинает подключать к нему сторонних селлеров.
marketing_claims.text_en: ЦБСТ takes the dual-use marketplace «Рой.Маркет» out of pilot mode and begins connecting third-party sellers to it.
marketing_claims.context: Коммерсантъ summary reposted by ЦБСТ, post 2414, 13.08.2026. The full Коммерсантъ article (doc/8878535) has not been read. Full article read 2026-10-01 (Коммерсантъ, Дмитрий Сотак, «Маркетплейс особого времени», 13.08.2026, газета №147 от 14.08.2026, s8866).

marketing_claims.text_ru: Онлайн-маркетплейс РОЙ.МАРКЕТ открыл защищённый канал продаж для производителей, дистрибьюторов и профессиональных селлеров товаров двойного назначения. В первую очередь площадка приглашает к сотрудничеству юрлица, которые уже работают на Wildberries, Ozon и других универсальных маркетплейсах.
marketing_claims.text_en: The online marketplace РОЙ.МАРКЕТ has opened a protected sales channel for manufacturers, distributors and professional sellers of dual-use goods. First of all it invites legal entities already working on Wildberries, Ozon and other universal marketplaces.
marketing_claims.context: ЦБСТ's own channel, post 2413, 13.08.2026. Also: «С 1 августа РОЙ.МАРКЕТ перешёл на следующий этап развития… с самостоятельной работой поставщиков»; post 2433 (20.08.2026): «Небольшая команда или независимый разработчик… имеют возможность стать поставщиком РОЙ.МАРКЕТ». So sellers are not limited to ЦБСТ residents by the operator's own wording.

marketing_claims.text_ru: «Рой.Маркет» был запущен в начале 2025 года и до сих пор работал в пилотном режиме. … Если на пилотном этапе значительная часть операций выполнялась командой площадки, то теперь селлеры смогут самостоятельно размещать товары, управлять ассортиментом, ценами и остатками, обрабатывать заказы и работать с документами через личный кабинет.
marketing_claims.text_en: «Рой.Маркет» was launched in early 2025 and until now ran in pilot mode. … While in the pilot a large part of operations was done by the platform's team, sellers will now be able to list goods, manage assortment, prices and stock, process orders and handle documents themselves through a personal account.
marketing_claims.context: Коммерсантъ, 13.08.2026 (s8866), reporting Безруков. Dates the launch to early 2025; says the pilot catalogue already includes «3D-принтеры, катушки с оптоволокном, антенны, зарядные устройства». Also: the commission will be «существенно ниже», logistics cost is borne by the seller, delivery moves to a distributed 4PL model; buyers stay a closed, authorised-access audience. Wildberries is said to treat finished army gear as a prohibited category.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Для стандартного подключения действует единая оферта. Для первого шага достаточно предоставить информацию о компании и ассортименте — команда платформы поможет подобрать категории и пройти подключение.
marketing_claims.text_en: A single offer applies to standard connection. For the first step it is enough to provide information about the company and its range; the platform team will help choose categories and complete the connection.
marketing_claims.context: ЦБСТ press release, cbst.ru, 13.08.2026 17:30 (s8867). Same release: «Учредители ЦБСТ – партия «Единая Россия», ПАО «Банк ПСБ» и некоммерческий фонд поддержки патриотических инициатив «Наша Правда»»; ЦБСТ's own wording that the platform «может стать заменой универсальных маркетплейсов» for sellers. The agency offer (s8817) names МПТМ as the Агент; the release names only ЦБСТ.

marketing_claims.text_ru: После проверки продукции и получения допуска разработчики смогут поставлять изделия непосредственно подразделениям-заказчикам.
marketing_claims.text_en: After product checks and receiving admission, developers will be able to supply products directly to customer units.
marketing_claims.context: Коммерсантъ, 06.08.2026 (s8865), «Воентеху подготовят площадки», reporting Безруков. A vetting step (проверка продукции, допуск) stands between a seller and military buyers; its criteria are not published.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Следующий этап развития РОЙ.МАРКЕТ — превращение в полноценную ИТ-платформу с моделью распределённой логистики, самостоятельной работой поставщиков, сквозной обработкой заказов, интеграциями и контролем доступа.
marketing_claims.text_en: The next stage of РОЙ.МАРКЕТ's development is its transformation into a full IT platform with a distributed-logistics model, suppliers working independently, end-to-end order processing, integrations and access control.
marketing_claims.context: ЦБСТ's own channel, post 2386, 05.08.2026 (s8850), on Безруков's statement at the Наблюдательный совет; the post says the platform «ранее функционировала в рамках пилота». The post names no logistics operator, bank or acquirer, so it does not close the open question on МПТМ's logistics and acquiring partners.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Кроме того, подключённые к РОЙ.МАРКЕТ подразделения могут рекомендовать нужных производителей и товары, которых пока нет в каталоге платформы.
marketing_claims.text_en: In addition, units connected to РОЙ.МАРКЕТ can recommend the manufacturers and goods that are not yet in the platform's catalogue.
marketing_claims.context: ЦБСТ's own channel, post 2433, 20.08.2026 (s8857), summarising Безруков's comment to ТАСС (the TASS original, tass.ru/ekonomika/28027659, returned 403 from this machine and is unread). The same post quotes him: РОЙ.МАРКЕТ «создавался под российские условия и конкретные потребности наших подразделений». Which units are connected is not stated.

open_questions.text: This entity's own _raw scaffold note (carried from the frozen pre-migration docs/_archive snapshot) states "100% ЦБСТ-owned until the stake's end-date of 12-14.07.2026" -- a specific, dated ownership-transition claim -- but no source for it could be located 2026-09-16: it does not appear anywhere in the current docs/index.html, and every EGRUL pull actually archived for this entity (ul-1257700021468-20260814192506.pdf, EGRUL_9714068459_20260907_ooo-mptm.pdf, EGRULAPI_9714068459_20260822_ooo-mptm.json) already postdates the 15.07.2026 access restriction and shows only "Доступ к сведениям ограничен" for учредители -- none of them could have been the source of a historical founders fact. No Aleph/OCCRP pull exists for this ИНН either. The underlying claim is plausible (fits the platform's own ЦБСТ-operator role throughout the brief) but its specific source has been lost between the archived scaffold and the current registry -- needs either a fresh full ЕГРЮЛ выписка (which may itself now be restricted) or locating whatever aggregator/cache the original scaffold note drew from.

The operator's name is masked on the live site: between the Wayback capture of 22.08.2026 (s8817, «ООО «МПТМ» · ИНН 9714068459» in the header, requisites printed in the offer) and 01.10.2026 (s8822, s8818, s8821) the public offer texts read «ООО «****»» and the requisites are shown only after login (s8820, «Обезличенные редакции открыты всем… реквизитами доступен после входа»). Why and when it was masked is not documented.

Acquirer and logistics partner are not named in the operator's own texts read (the supplier offer s8817, the platform rules s8821, the buyer offer s8818): they speak of «платёжные системы и эквайеры» and «Логистический партнёр» in general. An older note (the held notes/dossier_draft.html and a registry open question) names «MetaShip» as the logistics integrator and a 3DS payment gateway; no archived primary document for either is on file, so no acquiring_via or ships_via edge is recorded. Capture and read the source before recording one. 2026-10-02: the live site's HTTP headers (s8949; page s8950, «Вход в РОЙ.МАРКЕТ … Закрытая платформа инженерного снабжения») carry a Content-Security-Policy that permits form posts and frames to 3ds.payment.ru and test.3ds.payment.ru (a 3-D Secure card-payment gateway) and scripts and frames from widget.metaship.ru (a delivery widget). A CSP allow-list shows what the page may load, not who contracts with the operator: neither host is named as a partner in a document, so this narrows the search for the acquirer and logistics partner without naming either.

open_questions.text: screen_opensanctions.py (2026-08-24) surfaced that OpenSanctions' deduped profile for this ИНН carries an OFAC/EO14024 designation whose own explicit ID numbers actually belong to a separate, previously-untracked Tula entity (ooo-tsentr-bespilotnykh-sistem-tula, ИНН 7100032961, registered a year before this АНО). Do NOT read this as confirmation that АНО «ЦБСТ» itself carries a direct US OFAC designation under its own Moscow ИНН — that specific claim is NOT established. What IS established: a same-branded, earlier-registered Tula entity is OFAC-designated, and the exact relationship between the two needs a primary-source EGRUL/ownership check.

GUR's foreign-components-in-weapons catalogue lists two component sets for a weapon item titled "Delta (CBTS.611000, sample No.1)" and "...sample No.2)" — a long-range, gasoline-engine fixed-wing UAV (DLE-60 two-stroke engine, RFD900X long-range telemetry, airspeed/Pitot sensors, RTK navigation modules), pulled and read in full 2026-08-24 (23 components across both samples). CORRECTION (user-flagged, 2026-08-24): "CBTS" is NOT a plausible transliteration of ЦБСТ — the standard transliteration of Ц is "Ts", giving TsBST, not CBTS. There is no linguistic basis for reading "CBTS.611000" as a ЦБСТ reference; the resemblance is coincidental letter overlap only. GUR's own page gives no attribution whatsoever — no manufacturer, no company, no ИНН. Recorded here only because it was pulled and read; there is currently no basis to treat it as related to ЦБСТ, this registry's manufacturer roster, or any entity in it. Left as a parked, unattributed weapon-item record, not an open question implying a ЦБСТ connection.

Full scan of Сидякин's personal Telegram channel (@asidyakin, 2026-08-25, back to 22.02.2022 — real history starts 2025-05-19) surfaced three unresolved brand names in ЦБСТ/«Наша Правда» equipment-delivery posts (msg 6 and 145, both 19-20.05.2025, 76-я гвардейская десантно-штурмовая бригада): «Локтар» (программно-аппаратные комплексы — software-hardware complexes, no further detail), «Шорох» and «Грань» (комплексы связи для поддержки штурмовых групп — communications complexes for assault groups). No legal entity, ИНН, or manufacturer name given for any of the three — not yet resolvable to a registry entity. «Стратим» and «КингПро» drones in the same posts are already-known residents (corroborating evidence, not new). «Русак», «Голубь-Т», «Секира 13», «Воробей» in the same posts are also already-known products.

Same channel scan (@asidyakin, msg 680, 19.01.2026) also surfaced thermal sight brands «Кречет», «Аркон» and «Рубеж» delivered to БАРС-Курск brigade alongside UAZ vehicles — these are accessories/optics, not drones, and no manufacturer/ИНН given; unclear if these come from a ЦБСТ resident or a separate third-party defense-optics supplier. Not yet resolvable.

The «Переговорка» transcript's ₽14bn Единая Россия 'front aid' figure (since 2024) is party-wide across all humanitarian/military aid categories, not a ЦБСТ-specific or drone-only figure -- do not cite it as ЦБСТ's own budget or as UAV-specific spending without re-reading the exact wording. _raw.name: ООО «ЗИТ.ЦИ» | Отраслевой центр импортозамещения
_raw.role: Majority owner of Аэротехальянс. Wholly owned by ФГУП «ЗащитаИнфоТранс» (Ministry of Transport, 100%, ₽10k stake). Holds active FSB cryptography and FSTEC classified-information licences; OKVEDs cover transport-infrastructure vulnerability assessment and public-order activity. Its own FY2023–25 filings (pulled directly) show retained earnings growing ₽5.2m → ₽47.1m → ₽89.3m and headcount rising from 30 to 63 staff; its own FY2025 pояснительная записка states net profit rose 41.55% and reports opening two new field branches in 2025 — ОП «Верхний Ларс» and ОП «Тагиркент-Казмаляр», both sited at international land border checkpoints (Russia–Georgia and Russia–Azerbaijan respectively) — consistent with its stated transport-infrastructure-vulnerability-assessment OKVED and its classified-information licensing.

The existing 2022-11-28 director_history entry stands unchanged and no second entry is added.

Росгранстрой four-border cross-reference (2026-09-01): АО «ПМЦ «Авангард»» and ООО «ЗИТ.ЦИ» (Отраслевой центр импортозамещения) -- two separate ЦБСТ-network entities, no direct corporate ownership tie between them (ЗИТ.ЦИ is 100%-owned by ФГУП «ЗащитаИнфоТранс» Минтранса, source s0219) -- both hold direct government_contracts[] with the same federal customer, ФГКУ «Дирекция по строительству и эксплуатации объектов Росграницы» (Росгранстрой) or its regional branches, covering FOUR separate international/interregional border-crossing points:
  1. Хасан (China/North Korea border) -- ao-pmts-avangard, reg 1770982726625001602, ₽2,969,227,175, dated 2025-12-08, "Техническое оснащение комплексами технических средств безопасности, связи и специального контроля" (security/communications/special-control equipment), status "Исполнение" (in progress), source s3054.
  2. Ивангород (Estonia border) -- ao-pmts-avangard, reg 1770982726623000834, ₽214,862,173, Санкт-Петербургский филиал Росгранстроя.
  3. Калининград/Храброво (air border, Kaliningrad -- EU/NATO-adjacent) -- ao-pmts-avangard, reg 1770982726619000830, ₽31,790,000, Калининградский филиал, "в рамках ГОЗ" (state defense order), source s3046.

Same federal customer, four geographically distinct borders (Northeast Asia, EU/Baltic, Kaliningrad exclave, South Caucasus), two ЦБСТ-network suppliers -- reads as a genuine institutional pattern (border-security-technology work is this segment of the network's actual specialty with the state), not a coincidence of overlapping bids. Worth its own cross-reference line in the published narrative (docs/index.html) rather than staying scattered across two separate entity profile pages -- not yet written into index.html, flagged here as the next step if/when that section gets drafted.

_raw.name: АО УК «Азимут» | formerly «Аэронавигационные и информационные системы»
_raw.role: 25% owner of Аэротехальянс. Charter capital ₽12.8bn (confirmed via its own FY2021–25 filings, pulled directly). Same building. Director Saidov A.K. Non-public JSC, privately owned (ОКФС 16); primary OKVED is holding-company management (70.10.2), with stated activities spanning transport-management-system R&D, "information and economic security," and "external economic activity." Financially a stable holding: total balance grew ₽13.2bn → ₽17.1bn (2019–2025), almost entirely parked in securities/equity stakes (Финансовые вложения, steady ~₽13.9–14.5bn), with retained earnings climbing ₽300m → ₽3.5bn over the same period — real, growing profitability, not a shell. Its own FY2025 notes state explicitly: "Бенефициаром Общества является гражданин России" (the beneficiary is a Russian citizen) but withhold the name outright, citing "исключение санкционных рисков" (avoidance of sanctions risk) — the identical disclosure-exemption language already documented elsewhere in this brief for ДАР/ФКК's own board and related-party non-disclosures. marketing_claims.text_ru: Сейчас наши дроны на оптоволокне преодолевают расстояние до 40 км. Без красивых презентаций и сказок для телевизора. Просто инженерия, математика и русские мужики, которые умеют работать руками и головой.
marketing_claims.text_en: Right now our fiber-optic drones cover distances of up to 40 km. No pretty presentations or TV fairy tales. Just engineering, math, and Russian men who know how to work with their hands and their heads.
marketing_claims.context: Manufacturer's own technical/marketing claim about fiber-optic-guided strike-drone range, posted alongside a product close-up photo.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Произвели. Испытали. Применили. Разработкой и испытанием дронов ОВОД занимаются люди с реальным боевым опытом... Основатель ОВОДА с 2022 по 2026 год лично работал на многих направлениях от Крынок и Бахмута до Белгорода и Курска.
marketing_claims.text_en: Manufactured. Tested. Deployed. The people developing and testing OVOD drones have real combat experience... The founder of OVOD personally worked on many fronts from 2022 to 2026, from Krynky and Bakhmut to Belgorod and Kursk.
marketing_claims.context: Extended marketing narrative describing front-line field-testing as the company's core development method, including a joint trial with ФСБ ЦСН special forces.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Тяжелый ударный FPV-дрон «Провод» на оптоволокне отработал на рекордную для боевых условий дальность - 40 километров 400 метров и уничтожил там, на Сумском направлении, укропский склад с БК и ошивавшийся рядом личный состав противника.
marketing_claims.text_en: The heavy fiber-optic strike FPV drone "Provod" achieved a record combat-condition range of 40.4 km, destroying a Ukrainian ammunition depot and nearby enemy personnel on the Sumy front.
marketing_claims.context: Self-reported strike claim for the «Провод»/«ПрОвод» fiber-optic variant of the «Овод» family, framed as a range record.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Дроны на "леске" различаются длиной катушки. Сейчас катушки позволяют летать на 40 км, можно и дальше... Подсчет стоимости уничтоженной техники не ведется, но в целом можно считать 2-4 дрона на гаубицу или боевую машину. Фактически получается уничтожить ценное имущество стоимостью от 100 млн рублей дронами суммарной стоимостью меньше 1 млн рублей... Мы постоянно растем, совершенствуем свои дроны и увеличиваем объемы производства. В перспективе ждем появления изделий, способных работать автоматически с использованием ИИ.
marketing_claims.text_en: "Leash"-type drones differ by spool length. Spools now allow flight up to 40 km, and further is possible... The value of destroyed equipment isn't tracked, but roughly 2-4 drones are used per howitzer or combat vehicle. In effect, assets worth over 100 million rubles are destroyed using drones totaling under 1 million rubles... We keep growing, improving our drones and increasing production volumes. Going forward we expect products capable of working autonomously using AI.
marketing_claims.context: TASS-quoted ("ТАСС пишет про наши дроны") company statement on cost-effectiveness economics and a forward AI-autonomy roadmap.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Сегодня год с момента основания боевой группы "ОВОД" в составе отдела контроля и целевого применения производителя дронов "ОВОД". Боевая группа создана из опытных воинов - ветеранов СВО. Военные специалисты ОВОДА содействуют подразделениям МО РФ и других силовых служб в зоне СВО. Боевая группа "ОВОД" регулярно работает на сложных участках фронта, где занимается апробацией изделий и выполняет боевые задачи в роли беспилотного спецназа.
marketing_claims.text_en: Today marks one year since the founding of the OVOD combat group within the manufacturer's own control-and-target-application department. The combat group is made up of experienced SVO veterans. OVOD's military specialists assist units of the Russian MoD and other security services in the SVO zone. The OVOD combat group regularly operates in difficult front-line sectors, field-testing products and carrying out combat tasks in the role of unmanned special forces.
marketing_claims.context: 1st-anniversary announcement (founded ~28.08.2025) of the manufacturer's own in-house combat/field-testing detachment, staffed by SVO veterans and operating directly at the front — distinct from the earlier-documented general 'field-support sector' (msg 845), this is explicitly a combat unit performing military tasks, not just training/support.

battlefield_evidence.text_ru: Операторы БАРС-8 нашли и уничтожили самоходную гаубицу ВСУ западного образца стоимостью порядка 3 млн долларов четырьмя дронами ОВОД. Гаубица стоимостью до 3 млн долларов уничтожена дронами стоимостью порядка 6 тысяч долларов.
battlefield_evidence.text_en: БАРС-8 operators found and destroyed a Western-pattern self-propelled howitzer worth roughly $3M using four Ovod drones. A howitzer worth up to $3M destroyed by drones costing roughly $6,000 total.
battlefield_evidence.context: Third-party-attributed (named БАРС-8 reservist unit, not Овод's own marketing framing) cost-effectiveness battlefield claim, posted 05.08.2026.

battlefield_evidence.text_ru: Подразделения лётного батальона 88-й бригады Эспаньола стабильно продолжают боевую работу на Константиновском направлении СВО в окрестностях Часов Яра... На видео выше — нарезка поражений ПВД неприятеля несколькими точными ударами FPV-дронов самолетного типа системы «Привет-82» расчетами лётного отряда «Совы», расчетами «Овода» со своими средствами...
battlefield_evidence.text_en: Units of the 88th Brigade "Espanyola" flight battalion continue combat operations on the Konstantinovka front near Chasiv Yar... the video shows a compilation of strikes on enemy forward positions by "Privet-82" fixed-wing FPV drone crews, "Ovod" crews with their own equipment...
battlefield_evidence.context: Named military unit's (88th Brigade, callsign "Испанец"/Espanyola) own combat-application account with video footage, reposted on Овод's own channel — third-party framed, not the manufacturer's own marketing copy.

battlefield_evidence.text_ru: Уничтожение украинской боевой машины в зоне СВО 15-й отдельной ротой специального назначения на дронах ОВОД.
battlefield_evidence.text_en: Destruction of a Ukrainian combat vehicle in the SMO zone by the 15th separate special-purpose company with OVOD drones.
battlefield_evidence.context: The maker's own channel @tulaovod, post 956 (18.09.2026), with video: the maker's framing (asserted_by self). The unit is named only in the maker's post, so it does not enter military_units.json (peer audit 15.09.2026).

battlefield_evidence.text_ru: Минобороны России опубликовало видео, на котором запечатлено боевое применение FPV-дрона «Овод». На кадрах камикадзе поражает технику ВСУ.
battlefield_evidence.text_en: Russia's Defence Ministry published a video showing combat use of the «Ovod» FPV drone; the footage shows the kamikaze drone striking Ukrainian armed forces equipment.
battlefield_evidence.context: ЦБСТ post 2557 (22.09.2026, with video) relaying a Defence Ministry publication; the Ministry's own post is not archived, so this rests on ЦБСТ's report. The same post names the line as «команды Андрея Черезова» and lists the НРТК «Довод» for delivering FPV drones to the launch line.

open_questions.text: On 29.07.2026 founder Андрей Черезов was shot three times in Tula by an unidentified attacker who fled; a criminal case was opened. Овод's own channel frames this as one of a pattern of attacks targeting leading Russian drone developers, alongside a car-bomb attack the same week (05.08.2026) that seriously injured Владимир Ткачук, described as developer of «Упырь» ("Ghoul") combat drones — «Упырь»/Ткачук is NOT currently in this registry, a genuinely new adjacent-network lead not yet investigated.

PEP-adjacency lead, NOT independently confirmed: a 30.07.2026 forward on Овод's own channel, originally from war correspondent Анастасия Кашеварова's (@akashevarova) personal channel, claims Алексей Дюмин — while governor of Tula oblast — personally helped Черезов with his early drone development, before the enemy had comparable technology. This is a named, identifiable journalist's secondhand account, forwarded (not authored) by Овод itself — not corroborated by any Дюмин-side or Овод-official primary source in this pass. If confirmed, this would tie Овод's founding story directly to a now-senior federal security/defense-adjacent official; treat as an open lead requiring independent verification before use, not as an established fact.

products.description: First single-board (одноплатный) drone constructor -- flight controller, speed controller and radio comms integrated on one board, textolite frame. Per InC Russia (incrussia.ru): 80 km/h cruise speed, 35km control range, 80% localized components; purpose includes cartography, wildlife monitoring, search-and-rescue, cargo delivery up to 5kg. GD Игорь Лапин quoted directly.

Heavy multirotor UAV family for military/industrial cargo transport. Per ВПК.name interview with GD Игорь Лапин: designed payload 120kg with 40min flight time, powered by 45-49V onboard electrical system, controlled via the in-house «Пеппа» comms system, fail-safe controlled landing up to 35-40km from launch point.

Heavy FPV strike/logistics drone. Per ВПК.name interview with GD Игорь Лапин, quoting him directly: "мы можем уверенно заявлять, что он способен пролететь расстояние 25-30 км с боевой частью 12 кг" (25-30km range, 12kg warhead, per recent testing).

In-house UAV control/comms system operating on non-standard frequencies, used as the control system for the «Кощей» family (per ВПК.name interview, s8050). open_questions.text: PARENT ENTITY UNRESOLVED: per this presentation, "ООО «Решение»" is described as "головная компания ГК Логос" (the group's parent company) — an integrator with its own EW production, own registered software (Свидетельство №2025682258), 300+ units delivered to the SVO zone + 20+ to the rear, and named recipient units: 136 ОМБ, 10 СБ 69 ГМД, 3 МСБ 1009 МС, 377-й отдельный противотанковый дивизион, СГУП «Орлан» Белгород (бывший «Рубеж-31»). Presenting speaker: "Николай Владимирович, директор по развитию ГК Логос, ООО Решение". No ИНН/ОГРН for ООО «Решение» found yet — "Решение" is too generic a name to disambiguate via EGRUL name search alone; needs a targeted search (e.g. by the Rospatent software certificate №2025682258, or by a full-text press mention naming a director surname). NOT the same as the already-registered ooo-gk-logos (ИНН 3435149330, Volzhsky, founder Гарькуша В.В., director Бурлака П.А.) — that entity is modeled as a distribution/logistics arm (tier: plumbing, delivered «Дикобраз» hardware to «Наша Правда»/«Центр» grouping troops 03.07.2025) and is NOT confirmed to be corporately related to «ООО Решение», despite sharing the «Логос» brand and product line. Could be sibling companies in an informal group, or coincidental brand reuse — unresolved.

KEY PARTNERS listed on the presentation's closing slide: КЦПН, «Касперский Антидрон», «Арьергард», «проект Архангел». «Проект Архангел» is the SAME name as the adjacent-not-confirmed network already parked in memory (roymarket_archangel_adjacent_network) — this is now a SECOND independent surfacing of that name, this time as a stated operational partner of a ЦБСТ-claiming counter-UAV manufacturer group, not just a name collision. Worth re-examining whether «Архангел» actually has a real ЦБСТ tie via this route, rather than remaining purely adjacent.

RESOLVED (partial): "Николай Владимирович" from the spp.spb.ru deck is Арутюнов Николай Владимирович, директор по развитию ООО «Решение» ГК «Логос» — confirmed by a THIRD independent presentation of essentially the same pitch, this time at a Союз работодателей Ростовской области round table, 26.05.2026, ДГТУ (Rostov-on-Don). This same event also names ООО «Решение»'s actual Генеральный директор: Ляшенко Игорь Владимирович — EGRUL search by name alone did not disambiguate him (too many "ООО Решение" registrations nationwide, and the open API does not support compound name+director AND-queries) — still no ИНН/ОГРН for the entity.

MAJOR CROSS-LINK CONFIRMED: the Rostov round table's agenda item #3 ("Практический опыт создания, обучения, дообучения мобильных огневых групп (МОГ) на примере Республики Крым") was presented by Филиппов Михаил Геннадьевич, described as "руководитель Проекта «Архангел»" — the SAME PERSON already documented in the parked adjacent-network memory as @arhangel76 (Филиппов Михаил Геннадиевич, b. 17.11.1976, Лыткарино). This is a DIRECT joint appearance on the same panel as ГК «Логос», not just a name mentioned on a partner slide — meaningfully upgrades the «Архангел» connection from "listed as a partner" to "co-presents at the same regional government-adjacent events." Still does not by itself establish a ЦБСТ tie for Архангел (neither this event nor ГК Логос's own ЦБСТ claim is primary-sourced yet), but the recurrence is now strong enough to warrant a dedicated look next time this thread is picked up.

Also present at the same round table: Кудрявцев Анатолий Антонович, "начальник службы РЭБ штаба 4 армии ВВС и ПВО" — an active-duty military EW official from the 4th Army (Air Force and Air Defence) — attending/opening the session alongside ГК «Логос» and «Архангел». Worth noting as evidence of direct military-official engagement with this network's regional-defense pitch, though he is not himself part of either company.

Иванов Евгений Андреевич, described as "эксперт Университета НТИ 2035 ГК «Логос»", presented agenda item #4 at the same round table — a named individual affiliated with the Университет НТИ 2035 (a real state-linked technology-initiative university programme) acting in a ГК «Логос» capacity. No further identifying detail pulled yet.

RESOLVED: «ООО Решение»'s legal identity fully confirmed via full EGRUL extract (23.08.2026). ИНН 1001294845, ОГРН 1151001003230, registered 30.03.2015, Петрозаводск, Республика Карелия (Karelia) — this is the group's actual home region, not St. Petersburg/Leningrad oblast (Арутюнов's personal residence) or the Chernozem belt (the earlier speculative TG-handle read). Sole founder/director: Ляшенко Игорь Владимирович (100%, personal ИНН 100122155290 — a Karelia-issued ИНН, consistent with local residency), charter capital ₽10,000. Primary ОКВЭД 62.01 (software development) with secondary codes added 20.06.2025 that are a much better product match: 26.30.4 (antenna manufacturing), 26.51.2 (radar/radio-navigation/remote-control equipment manufacturing), 27.90 (other electrical equipment) — an OKVED-mismatch pattern (declared as software house, actually building RF/radar hardware) consistent with this project's recurring "officially X, in fact Y" pattern. The three hardware-specific OKVED codes were all added the SAME day the registered address changed (20.06.2025 vs 17.06.2025 per the extract) — i.e. the pivot into RF/EW hardware and the move to the current Petrozavodsk address happened within days of each other, roughly coinciding with the start of the regional pitch-deck circuit (spp.spb.ru April 2026, srro.ru Rostov May 2026).

IMPORTANT DISAMBIGUATION: a separately user-supplied ЕГРИП pull for "Ляшенко Игорь Владимирович" (ОГРНИП 325547600079000, registered 14.05.2025, Novosibirsk) carries a DIFFERENT personal ИНН (540507792793, a Novosibirsk-issued number) from ООО «Решение»'s founder (100122155290, Karelia-issued). Personal ИНН is permanent and does not change with relocation, so this is a NAME COLLISION — a different person who happens to share the same ФИО — not the same Ляшенко. Not merged; kept as a documented false lead so it isn't re-chased.

A ПрЭВМ (registered computer program) search for «Дикобраз» (2026-08-24, searchplatform.rospatent.gov.ru) found RU2024619301ПрЭВМ, "Программное обеспечение управления боем «Дикобраз»" (combat-control software), registered 2024.04.22 to ООО «Монолит» -- a company NOT currently in this registry, and NOT this entity's own name. Given «Дикобраз» is ГК «Логос»'s own branded product line, this is either a name collision or a genuine undisclosed subcontractor/software-supplier relationship -- worth checking ООО «Монолит»'s own filings/ИНН before drawing any conclusion.

products.description: Flagship-line FPV kamikaze quadcopter. 385x435x47mm, 0.612kg empty, 2kg payload, 5kg max takeoff weight. Cruise 80km/h, max 140km/h. Flight time 30min empty / 8min with max payload. Range 18km (1kg payload) / 10km (2kg payload). Control/video range up to 60km with relay. Wind resistance up to 15m/s. Modular comms (analog/optical-fiber/multi-frequency). Uses: reconnaissance, monitoring, anti-personnel/anti-armor strikes, fortified-position attacks, small-cargo/medical delivery up to 2kg.

"Flagship of the Пиранья product line" per the company's own catalog. 525x570x60mm, 0.845kg empty, 5kg payload, 9kg max takeoff weight. Cruise 80km/h, max 140km/h. Flight time 35min empty / 15min max payload. Range 44km (1kg) / 38km (3kg) / 5km (5kg). Control/video range up to 60km. EW-resistant with automatic frequency-hopping to maintain link when jammed. Site marketing name: "Убийца Abrams" ("Abrams killer") — see self-incriminating-copy note.

"Class speed leader" per catalog, 4-motor UAS. 742x683x85mm, 1.8kg empty, 6kg payload, 13kg max takeoff weight. Cruise/max 80/140km/h. Flight time 45min empty / 15min max payload. Range 37km (3kg) / 25km (6kg). Control/video range up to 60km. Also usable as an airborne relay platform. Doubles as kamikaze strike or covert scout with delivery up to 6kg to hard-to-reach targets.
Communication/control module line across six frequency bands: 185-215MHz, 285-315MHz, 490-520MHz, 685-715MHz, 900-930MHz, 2.3-2.4GHz. Various antenna types (Uda-Yagi, dipole, Moxon).
Fiber-optic control cable spools, 10-50km lengths (0.905-4.5kg), marketed as EW-immune ("недоступны для средств РЭБ").
Airborne signal-relay units, 148x92x35.5mm, 0.5-0.6kg, with mounts for both DJI and «Пиранья-13» platforms.

Quadcopter-type UAV, presented alongside «Пиранья 20» at HeliRussia 2026 (per press photo caption and coverage); cargo/logistics-oriented addition to the Пиранья line beyond the 7/10/13 kamikaze series. No individual specs captured yet.

Cargo-capacity UAV, max takeoff mass 20kg / payload 17kg per press coverage, cruise 80km/h / max 140km/h -- for cargo delivery to hard-to-reach areas and strikes on fortified positions/equipment. Presented at HeliRussia 2026 alongside «Пиранья 15»; separately reported (iz.ru) as launched into serial production with up to 30kg cargo capacity for frontline logistics.

Санкт-Петербургу (http://78.mchs.gov.ru/dejatelnost/Nadzornaya_deyatelnost_i_profilakticheck/Plany_i_rezultaty_provedeniya_planovyh_p/Plany_provedeniya_proverok/2019_god) и информационном стенде в ОНДПР Невского района УНДПР ГУ МЧС России по г. Санкт-Петербургу;задачами настоящей проверки являются:  предупреждение, выявление и пресечение возможных нарушении АО «Котлин-новатор», его руководителем и иными должностными лицами, его уполномоченными представителями обязательных требований и мероприятий в области защиты населения и территорий от чрезвычайных ситуаций природного и техногенного характера;  систематическое наблюдение за исполнением обязательных требований и мероприятий в области защиты населения и территорий от чрезвычайных ситуаций природного и техногенного характера;  предотвращение возможного причинения вреда жизни, здоровью граждан.Предметом настоящей проверки является:  соблюдение совокупности предъявляемых обязательных требований и мероприятий в области защиты населения и территорий от чрезвычайных ситуаций природного и техногенного характера. Предмет плановой проверки ограничивается перечнем вопросов, включенных в проверочный лист (список контрольных вопросов), используемый при осуществлении государственного надзора в области гражданской обороны при проведении плановых проверок по контролю за соблюдением установленных требований в области защиты населения и территорий от чрезвычайных ситуаций природного и техногенного характера.

litigation.subject_ru: Взыскание задолженности по договору поставки № 25/23 от 18.07.2023: 714 000 руб. основного долга и 2 038 470 руб. неустойки (0,5% за день просрочки, п.10.5.2 договора) за период с 30.12.2023 по 22.07.2025 с начислением по день фактического исполнения, плюс 107 574 руб. госпошлины. Судья Смирнова Г.Э.
litigation.note: MATERIALLY THE MOST IMPORTANT DOCUMENT IN THIS CLUSTER: the judgment itemises what was actually delivered under the УПД № 18 от 25.07.2023, and the goods are military. Two line items only: «Система сброса для гранаты типа «F1»» — a release/drop mechanism for an F1 fragmentation hand grenade — 30 units at ₽13,800 (₽414,000); and «Аккумулятор GAONENG GNB 1300MAH 14BV 100C XT60», 50 units at ₽6,000 (₽300,000). The second is a standard 4S FPV drone LiPo battery pack made by GAONENG (Shenzhen, China). A grenade-release mechanism plus FPV drone batteries is a munitions-dropping drone payload kit, and it is established here on the face of a Russian state arbitration court's own findings of fact, not on marketing copy or a Telegram claim. The delivery date (25.07.2023) puts it well inside the full-scale invasion. Recorded on both parties: НПО «Рустехдрон» as supplier, ООО «ДСГ» as buyer.

litigation.subject_ru: Взыскание невозвращённой предварительной оплаты (аванса) в размере 245 678 400 руб. по договору поставки товара № 27/10/25-Ф от 27.10.2025 и неустойки в размере 14 740 704 руб. за период с 01.04.2026 по 18.05.2026 с начислением по день фактического исполнения.
litigation.note: By value the largest documented intra-network transaction found so far: a ₽245,678,400 advance paid by НПО «Рустехдрон» to ООО «СПТ» under a supply contract signed 27.10.2025, against which the goods were never delivered. Settlement terms approved by the court: СПТ had already repaid ₽45,000,000 (платёжное поручение № 1811 от 30.06.2026) and acknowledged a remaining ₽200,678,400 debt, to be repaid ₽50m by 31.07.2026, ₽70m by 31.08.2026 and ₽80,678,400 by 30.09.2026; on full performance the plaintiff waives the неустойка. СПТ also agreed to compensate ₽542,128.80 of non-refundable state duty. Note the scale relative to the counterparty: СПТ was registered only 21.03.2024 (ОГРН 1247700253668) yet took a quarter of a billion rubles in advance eighteen months later. The subject of the supply contract is NOT stated in either archived filing — an open question. A related appeal by НПО «Рустехдрон» against a 20.05.2026 interim ruling was RETURNED unheard by the Ninth Arbitration Appeal Court on 07.08.2026 (№ 09АП-36457/2026, s0047) for failure to attach proof of the state duty.

"МЕСТЬ ДОБРОЙ ВОЛИ"/МДВ group name is an unresolved lead, not yet cross-checked against the registry.

cbst_tie.claim: ЦБСТ's own post of 12.08.2025 says it and ООО «ОПКБ ЭКСПЛОМЕТ» signed a strategic-cooperation agreement («соглашение о стратегическом сотрудничестве»), and that the next stage «предполагает» (envisages) joint development of remote demining systems and minefield mapping.
cbst_tie.evidence: ЦБСТ's own channel, t.me/ANO_CBST/1033, 12.08.2025 (Международный форум «Беспилотные системы: технологии будущего»): agreement signed by ЦБСТ generalny director Дмитрий Рубинштейн and ОПКБ «Экспломет» generalny director Алексей Фоминых. Post text: 'На полях Международного форума... Центр беспилотных систем и технологий (ЦБСТ) и ООО «ОПКБ ЭКСПЛОМЕТ» подписали соглашение о стратегическом сотрудничестве... Новый этап сотрудничества предполагает совместную разработку систем дистанционного разминирования, построения карт и границ минных полей, интеграцию беспилотников и программных решений для точного определения мест залегания мин.' On file as a transcript of the database text (s7595), not a capture of the page. The post is ЦБСТ's own account; it does not say what was agreed beyond the sentence quoted, and the joint development is described as planned, not done.

Thanks to our device's signal, the men were able to jump out of the vehicle in time and take cover in a built-up area. Other soldiers were less fortunate — their "Ural" truck was burned by an enemy drone.

battlefield_evidence.text_en: Soldiers on the Bakhmut direction recorded a review of the "Nabat V.2.C": catches the drone signal well and immediately; easy to operate; works without failure.

battlefield_evidence.text_en: NABAT.V3 delivered to the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant. The NABAT.V3 drone detector has been deployed at the Zaporizhzhia NPP. The system works together with a video-signal interception screen and is used for continuous airspace monitoring around the facility.

open_questions.text: One of Russia's most prominent heavy military-UAV manufacturer lineages (Orion/Sirius/Grom) sits directly upstream of an already-catalogued registry entity via 100% ownership (see ooo-aeromaks founders[]) -- worth a dedicated deeper pass on the Kronshtadt→Aeromax corporate history and any residual military-drone production continuing under either entity, separate from the civilian pivot the press coverage emphasizes.

Минпромторг России's national БАС-classification chart (s5342, «О реализации национального проекта «Беспилотные авиационные системы» в период до 2030 года», p.2) lists «SH-750 (Аэромакс)» as the representative example product for the вертолетный тип / тяжелый (более 500 кг) UAV category — the heaviest helicopter-type class. "SH-750" doesn't match any model currently in products[] on any of the three Аэромакс-named entities (ao-aeromaks: AS-32-10/AS-32-8/Д-12К fixed-wing/VTOL; ooo-aeromaks: B-120/B-200/B-700 helicopter-type, А-5/А-5 М/Л/A-50 aircraft/multicopter-type; ooo-gk-aeromaks: none listed). Given ooo-aeromaks already carries the B-series helicopter line and B-700 is noted as "in development — no dedicated page yet", SH-750 may be a renamed/rebranded designation for B-700 or a newer heavy model entirely — needs checking against the group's current product pages (aeromaks brand site/VK/Rosteh press) before wiring to any specific entity's products[].

litigation.subject_ru: Взыскание задолженности по договору поставки № 25/23 от 18.07.2023: 714 000 руб. основного долга и 2 038 470 руб. неустойки (0,5% за день просрочки, п.10.5.2 договора) за период с 30.12.2023 по 22.07.2025 с начислением по день фактического исполнения, плюс 107 574 руб. госпошлины. Судья Смирнова Г.Э.
litigation.note: MATERIALLY THE MOST IMPORTANT DOCUMENT IN THIS CLUSTER: the judgment itemises what was actually delivered under the УПД № 18 от 25.07.2023, and the goods are military. Two line items only: «Система сброса для гранаты типа «F1»» — a release/drop mechanism for an F1 fragmentation hand grenade — 30 units at ₽13,800 (₽414,000); and «Аккумулятор GAONENG GNB 1300MAH 14BV 100C XT60», 50 units at ₽6,000 (₽300,000). The second is a standard 4S FPV drone LiPo battery pack made by GAONENG (Shenzhen, China). A grenade-release mechanism plus FPV drone batteries is a munitions-dropping drone payload kit, and it is established here on the face of a Russian state arbitration court's own findings of fact, not on marketing copy or a Telegram claim. The delivery date (25.07.2023) puts it well inside the full-scale invasion. Recorded on both parties: НПО «Рустехдрон» as supplier, ООО «ДСГ» as buyer.

open_questions.text: RESOLVED via web search (23.08.2026): Андрей Иванов is a real, independently-documented person — multiple press profiles (МК Тула 03.07.2025, ТВ Звезда 16.10.2024, tsn24.ru 01.04.2025, zanmsk.ru) describe him as an engineer/developer who returned from Thailand at the start of the SVO to build FPV drones, founding «Овод» production ~2023 and later developing a fiber-optic heavy strike variant called «Провод»/«Овод-Про». He is NOT a pseudonym for Черезов Андрей Павлович (the confirmed legal owner/director of РЛВТ, ИНН 7100027464) — different name entirely, and press coverage treats him as the technical founder/public face while Черезов holds legal ownership. No person record created yet for Андрей Иванов — surname-only identification insufficient to anchor one (no patronymic, DOB, or personal ИНН found in this pass); worth a person record once more identifying detail surfaces.

litigation.court: Арбитражный суд Республики Татарстан (упрощённое производство)
litigation.note: Единственное известное судебное дело Ушкуйника — здесь Ушкуйник выступает истцом (в отличие от типичного паттерна ответчика по неустойкам у АО «НИИ СТТ»/АО «НПП Радар ммс»), взыскивая относительно небольшую сумму (~100.6 тыс. руб.) с контрагента в Иннополисе. Не установлена связь предмета договора №13-а с профильной (БАС/оборонной) деятельностью Ушкуйника — сумма и упрощённый порядок производства указывают на рутинный хозяйственный спор (возможно, аренда офиса/имущества в Иннополисе), не на профильный контракт. Три акта архивированы: s5285 (принятие иска, 01.09.2025), s5286 (уточнение исковых требований, 22.09.2025), s5287 (решение, 27.10.2025).

litigation.status: Иск удовлетворён в полном объёме решением от 27.10.2025 (упрощённое производство, ст.229 АПК РФ): взыскано 76,458.02 руб. долга + 24,107.05 руб. неустойки + 10,028 руб. госпошлины с ООО «Энергополис» в пользу Ушкуйника.
litigation.subject: Взыскание основного долга по договору №13-а от 10.07.2024 (76,458.92 руб.) и неустойки (24,107.05 руб.) — предположительно аренда/оказание услуг (условия договора №13-а не раскрыты полностью в доступных актах).

litigation.parties: АО «Лазерные системы» (ИНН 7819039902, истец) против Управления Федеральной антимонопольной службы по Новгородской области (ИНН 5321047553, ответчик); АНО «НПЦ «Ушкуйник»» (ИНН 5300010714) — третье лицо
litigation.subject: Оспаривание отказа УФАС по Новгородской области (решение № 053/07/3-456/2025 от 15.08.2025) в рассмотрении жалобы АО «Лазерные системы» на порядок проведения закрытого конкурса, организованного Ушкуйником — истец утверждал, что Ушкуйник обязан руководствоваться 223-ФЗ.
litigation.status: В иске отказано решением от 13.03.2026 (ч.3 ст.201 АПК РФ): суд согласился с УФАС, что Ушкуйник не относится к категории заказчиков, обязанных применять 223-ФЗ, и что ФАС не имела полномочий рассматривать жалобу по данной закупке.
litigation.note: Third-party win for Ушкуйник — a court explicitly confirmed it is NOT subject to 223-ФЗ compliance oversight as a procuring entity, a legally significant finding given the scale of its own sole-supplier equipment purchases recorded in government_contracts[] (many already cite 223-ФЗ in their own notice numbers despite this ruling).

HEADLINE FINDING: this entity is a direct, sole-source government supplier of drones the contract itself states are for the war. Two zakupki.gov.ru contracts (reg 2532103798924000157, ₽4.25m, 21.11.2024; reg 2532103798925000183, ₽3.11m, 18.12.2025) with a Новгородская область regional civil-defence agency state the contract subject verbatim: "Поставка беспилотных летательных аппаратов ... для нужд проведения специальной военной операции и выполнения специальных задач по обеспечению обороны и безопасности государства" -- not press paraphrase, the government contract document's own operative language. Both are sole-supplier awards under 44-ФЗ ст.93 ч.1 п.2 (supplier designated by presidential decree/order, not competitively selected). litigation.court: Арбитражный суд г. Москвы (первая инстанция); Девятый арбитражный апелляционный суд; Арбитражный суд Московского округа (кассация)
litigation.note: Полный четырёхлетний цикл (2022–2024): первая инстанция → апелляция → кассационная отмена → новое рассмотрение → отказ в иске → апелляция и кассация подтвердили отказ → поворот исполнения. Представитель истца в заседании 02.09.2024: Пашаев Р.М. (доверенность от 12.10.2022). Судья первой инстанции на всех этапах — Ласкина С.О. В отличие от пассивной модели ответчика, видимой в делах АО «НИИ СТТ», АО «НПП Радар ммс» демонстрирует реальную способность вести многоуровневую апелляционно-кассационную защиту и добилось полного освобождения от неустойки, а также подавало (неуспешно, отклонён к совместному рассмотрению) встречный иск к Минобороны о взыскании собственной задолженности. Хронология по всем 15 файлам дела архивирована в data/sources/A40-211563-2022_*.pdf (s5266–s5280); не все 15 файлов прочитаны построчно, но итоговая траектория подтверждена финальным определением от 02.09.2024 (s5280), которое пересказывает все промежуточные акты.
litigation.parties: Министерство обороны Российской Федерации (истец) против АО «НПП Радар ммс» (ответчик)
litigation.status: Итог: иск Минобороны отклонён в полном объёме. Первая инстанция (21.12.2022) первоначально взыскала ₽787,855.42 (пересчитано по методике "неустойка на партию, а не на весь контракт", со ссылкой на Президиум ВАС РФ №5467/14 — контракт содержал 9 самостоятельных обязательств поставки в разные воинские части/регионы); апелляция (18.04.2023) оставила решение без изменений по обеим апелляционным жалобам. Кассация (24.08.2023) отменила оба акта и направила дело на новое рассмотрение. При новом рассмотрении суд первой инстанции (15.12.2023) отказал Минобороны в иске полностью; апелляция (25.03.2024) и кассация (24.07.2024) оставили отказ без изменений. Основание: согласно Постановлению Правительства РФ №783 от 04.07.2018 (в ред. ПП №340 от 10.03.2022), заказчик обязан списать начисленную неустойку, если она не превышает 5% цены соответствующего этапа контракта — пересчитанные ₽787,855.42 составляли менее 5% от ₽3,653,795.48 (цена партии), то есть Минобороны было обязано списать неустойку, а не взыскивать её через суд. Определением от 02.09.2024 суд удовлетворил заявление АО «НПП Радар ммс» о повороте исполнения (возврат средств, уплаченных по отменённому решению).
litigation.subject: Взыскание неустойки за просрочку поставки по государственному контракту от 18.12.2019 №1922187100412412209207625 (₽73,075,909.53) на изготовление и поставку береговых автоматизированных метеорологических станций ПИГМА-3 с ППИ-2 комплекса «Якорь» для гидрографических служб Северного и Тихоокеанского флотов; просрочка 363 дня по партии 2021 года (₽22,388,470.79).

Предметом настоящей проверки является:   соблюдение совокупности обязательных требований в области защиты населения и территорий от чрезвычайных ситуаций природного и техногенного характера. Предмет плановой проверки ограничивается перечнем вопросов, включенных в проверочный лист (список контрольных вопросов), используемый при осуществлении федерального государственного надзора в области защиты населения и территорий от чрезвычайных ситуаций природного и техногенного характера при проведении плановых проверок по контролю за соблюдением обязательных требований в области защиты населения и территорий от чрезвычайных ситуаций природного и техногенного характера.

Later: ЦБСТ post 2074 (14.04.2026, online application platform launched jointly; «Центр беспилотных систем и технологий является партнёром спецпрограммы Ростеха») [s8654]; ЦБСТ post 2343 (21.07.2026, «Наша организация отвечает за экспертизу и поддержку развития отобранных проектов») [s8655]; Ростех post rostecru/12363 (21.07.2026, «Среди партнёров проекта - ЦБСТ…», operator Академия Ростеха) [s8656].

open_questions.text: zakupki scan for ИНН 7704274402 is truncated: the scan log records hit_count=45 but only 10 reg_numbers were collected — a page-1 truncation predating zakupki_batch_pull.py's pagination fix. The 35 uncollected hits have never been seen. The 2026-09-05 closure (all 10 archived cards are Минздрав РФ COVID-era medical procurement) therefore rests on a partial sample. Re-run `zakupki_batch_pull.py scan --inn 7704274402 --force` before treating this entity's procurement footprint as characterised.

Who signed, and for what money: the agreement text is not on file. ЦБСТ says it includes the programme's ЦБСТ-run accelerator track and «предложения по мерам господдержки»; the prize fund is stated as ₽30m, grants of ₽3–5m (s8653). Whether ЦБСТ receives any funding or data from Ростех under it is not stated in either channel.

Co-signatories and partners not yet on file as entities: Агентство стратегических инициатив (АСИ), Корпорация МСП (signatories), and, per Ростех post 12363, фонд «Защитники Отечества», ОДД «Народный фронт «За Россию» and Академия Ростеха (operator). Чемезов Сергей Викторович signs for Ростех and has no person record: no source on file gives his date of birth, so none was entered.

Court approved a settlement (мировое соглашение) 14.01.2026 (s0023) confirming АО «Кронштадт» owed АО «НИИ СТТ» exactly ₽196,120,339.87 as of that date — ₽168,927,597.18 under contract №2227187340721412408225955/К-3-2022/586 (22.08.2022) and ₽27,192,742.69 under №40-ОД/2021 (10.12.2021) — on a 5-month installment schedule (Dec 2025-Apr 2026) into two named Промсвязьбанк Ярославский-филиал accounts, with НИИ СТТ waiving the remaining neustoika claim in exchange, but reinstating the full original penalty if any installment is more than 5 business days late. A 22.05.2026 order (s0024) shows only a typo-correction motion on the settlement text, not a breach — case remained procedurally live for that narrow purpose as of a 02.07.2026 hearing (s0025), not reopened on the merits. This is a directly confirmed, court-documented ₽196.1m intercompany debt between two EU-sanctioned network entities — among the largest single figures established anywhere in this registry.

Found 2026-08-30 reading the 83 previously-unwired contract cards already archived from an earlier scan/fetch-contracts pass (only 4 of 86 total hits had been wired before this). Not wiring all 49 as separate rows to avoid registry bloat for a single recurring customer relationship — see data/sources/ZAKUPKI_contract_<regNumber>_*.html for the full regNumber list, archived under supplier ИНН 6730046954. Largest single contract (reg. 1501200927916000097, ₽10.2m, 06.05.2016) cited as source. в/ч 35533's specific mission/identity not independently verified — flagged for further research, not asserted. IDENTITY (per agentura.ru, an independent OSINT profile of Russian security-service institutions — not independently corroborated beyond this source): в/ч 35533 is identified as ФСБ's «Научно-исследовательское подразделение ФСБ №1» (НИИ-1 / Институт специальной техники), based in г. Балашиха, Московская обл., мкр. Павлино, originating from ЦНИИСТ (Центральный научно-исследовательский институт специальной техники), founded 1955 under KGB's Оперативно-техническое управление, previously operating under the cover name «завод «Прогресс»». Its stated research areas include digital signal processing, wireless-network equipment, encryption, and voice recognition/synthesis ("automatic recognition of individuals by voice" and voice-imitation methods) — FSB internal special-technology R&D, not a line combat unit. If this identification holds, АО «НИИ СТТ» has been a recurring 2011-2022 supplier to FSB's own internal surveillance/signals-technology institute, not merely "a military customer" in the generic sense — a materially different and more significant relationship for the sanctions case. open_questions.text: A direct kad.arbitr.ru participant search on this entity's own ИНН (6730046954) returns "Найдено 28 дел", of which only 10 are currently structured in litigation[] above. Two screenshots (2026-09-03): s5336 is page 1 of 2 (~15-16 of its ~25 rows visible in the screenshot, cut off by viewport height around the 25.05.2020 row — the remaining ~9-10 rows on page 1, roughly dating between 2019 and mid-2020, are still uncaptured); s5339 is page 2 of 2 and IS fully visible (only 3 rows): А72-509/2018 (АО «НИИ СТТ» истец vs ООО «ГЦ ТУЛЗ» ответчик, АС Ульяновской области), А62-6361/2016 (АО «НИИ СТТ» истец vs ООО «Тольяттинский завод грузоподъемного оборудования» ответчик, АС Смоленской области), А62-727/2013 (ЗАО «НИИ СТТ» истец vs ООО НПО «Росинмаш» ответчик, АС Смоленской области — note ЗАО, the entity's older legal form, consistent with director_history). New case numbers visible on s5336 (page 1) not yet individually verified via their own case cards: А62-9256/2025 (ООО «Авто-Исузу Сервис» истец), А62-6891/2025 (АО «НИИ СТТ» истец vs ООО «Проектно-монтажная фирма «Запсибэлектромонтаж» ответчик, name truncated in screenshot), А62-10864/2024 (Исмаилов Дамир Афганович, individual, истец), А40-145369/2024 (АО «НИИ СТТ» истец vs ООО «Атлант-Кран» ответчик), А62-1716/2024 (ЗАО «Смоленскаэротранс» / АО «Спецавтохозяйство», cross-listed as both истец and ответчик — this entity's own connection to the case isn't visible in the truncated view and needs its own case-card check before assuming it belongs on this list at all), А62-8894/2023 (АО «НИИ СТТ» истец vs АО «Интеграл-Запад» ответчик), А62-3012/2022 (АО «НИИ СТТ» истец vs ООО «Инвестиционно-промышленный холдинг» ответчик), А56-5977/2022 (АО «Научные приборы» истец, St. Petersburg court). According to information we get from our military, FPV drones equipped with Kuznechiks have struck hundreds of units of military equipment, including heavily armored Western-made examples.

battlefield_evidence.text_en: The Kuznechik communications/control system for FPV drones is actively used by Russian forces in the SVO zone... Barashkov noted he cannot disclose the quantity of systems delivered or their distribution among units, as this information is classified.
battlefield_evidence.context: Independent confirmation via Народный фронт (ONF, a state-linked movement) → ТАСС → vz.ru/ridus.ru republication (08.04.2025), distinct from Гагаринг's own marketing copy. REFINED (2026-09-03, via a real browser session — nspd.gov.ru's public search API returns clean JSON in-browser even though a bare curl request gets WAF-403'd, since the site's JS challenge/session cookies aren't present outside a real browser context): the address "ул. Одесская, д. 48/3" is NOT one building inside a broader 23-building "48" complex as earlier assumed — it is itself a distinct multi-building industrial site. A direct NSPD search for "Краснодар Одесская 48/3" returns at least 19 separately-cadastred buildings all sharing that exact address: производственный корпус (23:43:0302010:387, 1972, 3,873.6 m², the one already flagged), ремонтно-механический участок, мазутохранилище (fuel-oil store), лесосушильная камера (23:43:0302010:399, wood-drying chamber — suggests a former Soviet woodworking/furniture-factory site), неcколько складов, механический цех, служебно-бытовой корпус №9, проходная (checkpoint), плюс a combined-suite listing ("д. 48, пом. 1,2,3..."). None of NSPD's public building records expose an owner/tenant name (Rosreestr redacted this from public output after the 2017 privacy amendments — only 'Частная'/'Собственность' shows), so this still doesn't identify which specific building Гагаринг's КПП 231045001 subdivision actually occupies. Resolving that requires either a paid EGRN extract naming the actual right-holder for one of these cadastral numbers, or independent evidence (a photo/video, a delivery address, a job posting) pinning Гагаринг to one specific building within this complex.

The 07.08.2026 'Юрист по договорной и судебной работе' vacancy (s5419) explicitly requires 'опыт работы в сфере ГОЗ не менее 2х лет' and 'Практический опыт работы с Федеральным Законом № 275-ФЗ (ГОЗ)' — Гагаринг's own job posting language self-identifies гособоронзаказ (State Defense Order) legal work as part of the role, alongside ordinary 44-ФЗ/223-ФЗ contract work. This is a real self-admission worth pursuing further (e.g. a targeted search for Гагаринг as a subcontractor to a named prime, since the earlier Чадаев repost describes Барашков personally delivering comms kits rather than a public tender).

_corrected: 2026-08-25: OSINT research pass clarifies the designation mechanism and product line. Radiofid's actual commercial line is legitimate industrial GSM/GPRS/4G modems, routers, and GPS trackers under the iRZ brand (sold since ~2005/2010, official iRZ partner/distributor in Russia — radiofid.ru, iot.ru/catalog/radiofid) — no UAV-specific product line found. The sanctions nexus (US State Dept, 23.08.2024) is COMPONENT PROCUREMENT, not drone manufacturing: designated as part of Maxim Marchenko's illicit procurement network, receiving >$475,000 of Common High Priority List (CHPL) microelectronics from Hong Kong-based Alice Components Co Ltd in Jan 2024 alone, alongside Türkiye-based Kayra Elektronik Limited Sirketi. Source: 2021-2025.state.gov/new-measures-to-degrade-russias-wartime-economy/. This is a materially different profile than a UAV-parts manufacturer — worth re-tagging or noting explicitly in any brief narrative text rather than grouping it with the roster's actual drone/detector manufacturers.

government_contracts.note: Sole-supplier procurement (44-ФЗ ст. 93 ч.1 п.9 — emergency/disaster-response grounds), concluded 29.10.2024 — during the active Kursk-oblast incursion. Delivery: г. Курск, ул. Можаевская, 6. Спецификация (Приложение к Контракту, source s1459 — an 11-page scanned PDF; pages 6-11 with the actual spec table exceed this project's standard 5-page OCR cap and needed a manual full-document OCR pass) specifies 184 units at ₽88,000/unit. Customer signed by Лунев Иван Иванович (начальник ГУ МЧС России по Курской области, действующий на основании Положения). Full legal justification chain, per «Обоснование заключения Государственного контракта» + «Обоснование начальной (максимальной) цены контракта» (source s1460, dated 28.10.2024): triggered by Курск governor's emergency decree (Распоряжение Губернатора Курской области от 07.08.2024 № 233-рг), elevated to federal-level emergency by Правительственная комиссия по предупреждению и ликвидации ЧС (протокол от 09.08.2024 № 9), budget authorized 17.10.2024 (₽16,192,000) per MCHS Minister генерал-лейтенант А.В. Куренков's decision on a докладная записка from советник Министра полковник Д.В. Мартынов (04.10.2024 № ДЗ-130-3787-АК). The justification text explicitly cites "постоянными неизбирательными террористическими атаками ВСУ" (constant indiscriminate terrorist attacks by the Armed Forces of Ukraine) and a counter-terrorism-operation regime in force in Курская область since 11.08.2024 (УФСБ России по Курской области приказ от 09.08.2024 № 289) as the operational need. NMTsK (starting price) was computed at ₽17,418,667.28 via comparable-market-price analysis; the actual contract price (₽16,192,000) was set to the lowest of several supplier price quotes gathered during that monitoring — confirming other suppliers' pricing was canvassed even though the award itself was sole-source. Signed for the customer by Заместитель руководителя ГУ МЧС России по Курской области А.Н. Ахезин and Начальник управления информационных технологий и связи, полковник внутренней службы В.П. Ганыш. УПД (source s1459-adjacent, same file family) independently confirms 184 units delivered 18.11.2024.

This record exists to hold Проект КБ «Архангел»'s own self-published product/technical claims without conflating them with the unrelated legal entity. FOUNDING HISTORY (2026-09-04, s5475, close-read of projectArchangel's pre-2025 archive): the channel's own first posts (msg 9-10, 2022-11-07) describe a grassroots, explicitly non-commercial, non-partisan FPV-drone assembly-and-donation initiative ("Данная инициатива не имеет отношения ни к одному объединению, организации, политической партии") — the project did not begin as a manufacturer or a legal entity. Through late 2022/early 2023 it operated under a dual "Открытое небо"/"АРХАНГЕЛ" branding, coordinating a multi-city volunteer network (Тверь, Ижевск, Казань, Екатеринбург, Мурманск/Архангельск ["Рокот"], Великий Новгород, Ростов, Набережные Челны) via named regional contacts, with a "Народный ВПК" ('People's defense-industry') framing already in use as early as msg 140 (2023-02-01) — nearly a year and a half before the "Ассоциация Народный ВПК" formal-membership announcement already on file (2024-06-20, Archangel_Forum#98621, s5463). No legal-entity registration or drone-manufacturing claim appears in this early period — those emerge only later (see ooo-arkhangel-* family, all registered 2025-2026). This full early-history archive (1,853 native posts, 2022-11-07 to 2025-01-22) has been sampled but not fully close-read line-by-line past this founding period; a deeper pass could still surface the exact point the project shifted from volunteer drone-donation to its own manufacturing/training business.

products.description: Self-described as "по сути, управляемая ракета с вертикальным взлётом или возможностью размещения на самолёте-матке" (in essence a guided rocket with vertical takeoff, or carriage on a mothership aircraft). Range up to 50km, max speed 340km/h, cruise 100-120km/h (33% power); 200+km/h needs 50% power at reduced 25-30km range. Intended use case: paired with air-defense radar (РЛС ПВО), operator guides the drone (fitted with a corner reflector) onto target by instruments. Full open-source build files (3D-printable PLA-CF airframe, Betaflight config, BOM) published publicly by the project's own channel for free self-assembly. B2B integration channel offered for aircraft/radar/ground-vehicle (БЭК) integration via @arhangel_channel_bot.

Multi-drone control architecture allowing an operator to deploy and switch between several drones from cover ("высаживать и переключаться между ними... не выходя из укрытия"). Developed for ambush-drone (засадные) tasking, self-described as also suited to ПВО/interceptor drones. Publicly endorsed on-record by an unnamed combat participant quoted in the announcement post.

Unified airspace surveillance-and-strike complex combining radar/video detection with interceptor-drone engagement. 15km monitoring radius, AI-based automatic target engagement, capacity for 17 interceptor drones per unit; operator role reduced to a single switch-toggle at the engagement moment. Press-quoted (paraphrase, not verbatim — see s5459) description from Филиппов: the system can replace the work of several mobile fire groups (МОГ). Described as a collaboration between Проект «Архангел» specialists and unnamed colleagues in St. Petersburg.

This post links two further, distinct, NOT-yet-scraped channels: t.me/proekt_arhangel (cited twice as a related/parent channel, distinct handle from @projectArchangel) and t.me/malyha_ww (video build instructions — "малыха" matches the BOM's "Малая ДР" naming for this small variant). BOM line item "Связь: Гермес или аналоги" ("Hermes comms, or equivalent") is a generic reference, not a specific vendor citation — plausibly, but NOT confirmed to be, the same «Гермес» tactical-comms brand sold commercially by `npo-kaysant` (ИНН 7733393203, see that entity's merged `kb-germes` alias). Left as an open lead, not merged. RESOLVED 2026-09-04 (via a web search, then confirmed against the private Академия chat's own msg 110720, s5457): the channel named in that chat, "ГЕРМЕС - ППРЧ связь, мачты, защита от дронов," is confirmed via its own Telegram title ("...НПО КАЙСАНТ") to be `npo-kaysant`'s (ИНН 7733393203) own commercial channel (@germesfpv). This IS the same «Гермес» brand referenced generically in the BOM.

Self-description (23.10.2025, s5456): "Проект «Архангел» имеет: сеть своих учебных центров; профессиональные боевые расчеты; ... опыт подготовки дроноводов в зоне СВО, исчисляемый несколькими тысячами пилотов; производственные мощности; мощную партнерскую сеть предприятий" (a network of its own training centers, professional combat crews, experience training drone pilots in the SVO zone numbering several thousand, production capacity, and a strong partner network of enterprises) — the project's own claim of scale, not independently verified.

The private "Академия Противодействия БПЛА" chat (channel_id 1859964206, already scraped, 5795 posts) carries 387 "Архангел" mentions and 147 warhead/fragmentation-term mentions — only one specific thread (msgs 110701-110720) has been close-read so far. A full close-read of this chat is a real next step, likely to surface further weapons-development detail beyond the polished public-channel framing.

A build variant using "судоплатовских комплектующих (ВТ 40)" (components from "Судоплатов"/"НСУ 2.0") is offered alongside the standard kit — the same rival network Проект Архангел publicly denied supplying in 2024 (see the parked roymarket_archangel_adjacent_network memory's "Гермес comms" note). Suggests a more complex relationship than pure rivalry — at minimum component-level compatibility. Not investigated further.

A Telegram channel named "ГЕРМЕС - ППРЧ связь, мачты, защита от дронов" is referenced by name (no handle) as the home channel for the «Гермес коллектив» system — not yet identified/scraped. May or may not be the same «Гермес» brand sold commercially by `npo-kaysant` (ИНН 7733393203).

Full-corpus scoped mining pass (2026-09-04) over all four Филиппов/Архангел-linked channels (Archangel_Forum 73,085 posts, projectArchangel 10,042, proekt_arhangel 1,073, the private Академия chat 5,795 — 65,454 non-empty posts scanned) confirms the project's own multi-platform contact roster from its own recurring signature block (msg projectArchangel#132, #9910): own training site bpla.archangel.school, VK (vk.com/id729012386 — appears 337-401x as the project's official VK link), MAX messenger (multiple join links, incl. a project-wide chat), plus named contact-handles for three distinct training-intake functions: @Coordinator_Archangel_Project (document intake — passport/military ID/СНИЛС/ИНН/bank details for enlistment), @VERA_consultant_Archangel (training program consultant), @Natalia_Archangel_Project (пункт: "Набор добровольцев, оформление" — volunteer recruitment processing). No full legal names attached to any of the three handles in the scanned text — not promoted to people.json pending a name. No Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook, or Odnoklassniki presence found belonging to the project itself — the handful of Instagram/Facebook links in this 65k-post corpus are unrelated third-party equipment-sourcing references embedded in a single post (projectArchangel#3534), not the project's own accounts.

«Малыха» (t.me/malyha_ww, referenced twice already as an unscraped build-video channel) is now fully resolved as a multi-platform training-video operation, per its own self-published contact block (projectArchangel#10301, 2026-06-14): Telegram t.me/malyha_ww + feedback bot @malyha_ww_bot, RuTube rutube.ru/channel/59281618, VK vk.com/malyha_ww. t.me/sudoplatov_official identified (14 cross-posts in projectArchangel/Archangel_Forum, 2023-2024) as the rival "Судоплатов" network's own public channel — this is the network whose "судоплатовских комплектующих (ВТ 40)" component variant was offered alongside the standard «Архангел» build kit (see the still-open component-compatibility question logged 2026-09-04 from s5457). Not scraped yet — a future step for resolving that lead, not chased further this pass.

«Ворон-оптоволокно» (t.me/voronoptovolokno) — per a direct self-published account (projectArchangel#9215, undated but positioned late Dec 2025/Jan 2026 in the feed), the founder of Проект «Архангел» personally visited the «Ворон» team, described as a field-repairable fiber-optic-cable manufacturer for FPV drones; the post states «Ворон» is relocating its fiber-optic production to Krasnodar Krai (the same region as Проект «Архангел»'s own Туапсе base) and the two projects plan joint operator training. No legal entity/ИНН resolved for «Ворон»/«Ворон-оптоволокно» yet — worth an EGRUL name search given the confirmed direct founder-to-founder relationship, distinct from a mere equipment mention.

POSSIBLE cross-network overlap, NOT confirmed: projectArchangel#9534 (undated, positioned ~Feb 2026 in the feed) is signed "Геннадий Архангельский" and describes personally sourcing/mounting ten four-barrel ЯкБ-12.7mm aviation machine guns for a customer's mobile counter-UAV fire groups (МОГ), with his own MAX channel max.ru/arkhangelfront (also cross-posted as t.me/arkhangelfront, 11x). This surname is otherwise ONLY attached in this registry to Архангельский Геннадий Евгеньевич (`arkhangelskiy-gennadiy-evgenevich`), director/co-founder of the separate, Гагаринг-adjacent АНО «Архангел» / «Архангел Легион» (ИНН 2315233718) — also a Krasnodar Krai operation. The projectArchangel post gives no patronymic, so this CANNOT be treated as the same person without further verification (a namesake, or a shared surname/brand coincidence, is equally plausible). If confirmed, this would be the first direct personal link found between Филиппов's Проект «Архангел» and the Гагаринг-adjacent «Архангел Легион» network — flagged here specifically so it is not silently missed, but NOT merged or asserted as fact.

КБ «Перит» (t.me/kbperit, 33 cross-posts) advertises an ОПУ (опорно-поворотное устройство, pan-tilt antenna mount) product "Голова" in the network's channels, with its own "@kbperit_admin" contact for "Сотрудничество и реклама" (cooperation and ADVERTISING) — reads as a paid cross-promotion, not a confirmed corporate partnership with Проект «Архангел». Noted, not investigated further; same treatment applies to ~50 other one-off legal-entity mentions (component/equipment vendors named in passing across the 65k-post scan) that were not individually triaged this pass — see the scoped mining report for the full list if a specific one becomes relevant later.

First close-read pass (2026-09-04) over Archangel_Forum's substantive native posts (33 of 1,633 "Архангел"-mentioning posts exceed 400 characters — the rest, plus the remaining 71,452 non-"Архангел" posts in this 73,085-post forum, remain unread; top-viewed posts are confirmed generic war-news reposts, not project content). Confirms two additional training locations beyond Туапсе/Запорожье: a Ставропольская школа (announced June 2024, physically "на территории Луганской народной республики", recruiting instructors incl. combat-engineer/sapper and tactical-medicine roles, contact @bpla_2023) and a Moscow training cohort ("третий поток в Москве", referenced Nov 2024). A 2025-11-22 post narrows the MoD-cadet training location specifically to Запорожье/Крым, with a formal Yandex-Forms enrollment process and "диплом государственного образца" (state-standard diploma, verifiable via Госуслуги) on completion — a materially more institutionalized credentialing detail than previously documented.

UNATTRIBUTED — private Академия chat (2026-08-19/20/27, this dump has no per-message sender/username field, so no identifier can be attached; a lead, not a citable claim against any specific person/entity).
