From the first close-read pass of Archangel_Forum (channel_id 1814184028, 73,085 posts, distinct from the main @projectArchangel channel — a member-facing FPV-build/marketplace/support space, not institutional announcements; overwhelmingly parts sales and firmware troubleshooting). msg 30750 (2024-01-08) distributes a roster of ~35 named local contacts (Telegram handles) across dozens of Russian cities plus occupied Crimea/southern Ukraine, offering free DJI Mavic firmware modification ('1001,' — a real, independently well-documented Russian-developed DJI jailbreak, per Forbes/dronexl.co/Fletcher Russia-Eurasia Program coverage, claimed to have modified 100,000+ drones by mid-2024) — this specific variant strips DRONE ID/geofencing and REPLACES the drone's self-identification string ('about,' command output changes from 'Slava Ukraini' to 'Russian Hackers'). New here: confirmation that Archangel_Forum itself served as ONE distribution channel into this broader firmware-modification ecosystem, not just a passive audience, with a specific city/handle roster as of Jan 2024. No source_id — the broader '1001' phenomenon is already externally documented, only the distribution-channel role is new to this investigation. Separately (msg 30851, 2024-01-09): a forum poster self-identifies with callsign «Ворон» — 'Инженер-конструктор 3 категории Научно-исследовательский институт МАИ РФ кафедра №602 Конструкторское бюро «Искатель»', serving since Sept 2023 in 'ДРБ «Родня»' on FPV work. Possible but UNCONFIRMED tie to the already-documented «Ворон»/«Ворон-оптоволокно» fiber-optic-cable manufacturing project this entity's own record already flags (Filippov personally visited that team; production relocating to Krasnodar Krai) — same callsign, plausible engineer-behind-the-team fit, but no document directly links this forum poster's MAI/КБ Искатель affiliation to that specific team; flagged as a lead, not merged.

Archangel_Forum msg 104088 (2024-07-05), part 8 of a self-run '#FPVtest «Народное тестирование»' (People's Testing) series comparing FPV/reconnaissance drones from 8 different producers on standardized range/payload/EW-resistance/kit-completeness criteria. Results: 1st place (86/100) — «ПВХ-1» by АО «Обуховский завод» (СПб) — a major state defense-industrial enterprise (Алмаз-Антей concern's own St. Petersburg plant), competing on the SAME informal testing ground as small volunteer producers, a notable institutional-scale signal; 6.8km max range, 10.8km/7.2km/8.1km at 1/1.5/2kg payload respectively, passed EW-resistance test. 2nd place — «Овод» by ООО «Воздушный тракт» (Tula) — new named entity, not yet in this registry. 3rd place — «Гортензия» by ИП Кудряшов, St. Petersburg — RESOLVES a recurring partner nickname ('Гортензия Питер') cited by name in dozens of the network's own early-2023 gratitude posts (already read in the projectArchangel early-history archive) without any legal identity previously attached — now identified as an individual entrepreneur, Кудряшов, based in St. Petersburg. None of the three (Обуховский завод, Воздушный тракт, ИП Кудряшов) yet promoted to full entities.json records — flagged as leads for a future EGRUL/ИНН pass, not yet independently verified beyond this forum post. Also worth noting: msg 104010 (same date) is a lengthy essay on drone-operator training philosophy signed '(с) Чадаев' — Алексей Чадаев, the political strategist already flagged elsewhere in this investigation's orbit for a personal-friendship framing with Гагаринг's Барашков (per the pending Гагаринг wide-net plan, msg 5013/chadayevru) — appearing here in the Архангел forum's own feed. Likely just general commentary reposted/read widely rather than an organizational tie between the two networks; noted as a possible cross-network contact point, not asserted as a link.

Follow-up on the ООО «Воздушный тракт» (Tula, brand «Овод», 2nd place in the Archangel_Forum's own 'Народное тестирование' series, see the Обуховский завод/Гортензия note above): Archangel_Forum msg 179660 (2026-07-30) reports an assassination attempt against the company's named founder/director, Андрей Павлович Черезов, framed as a rallying moment ('НАС НЕ ЗАПУГАЛИ — НАС РАЗОЗЛИЛИ') — he reportedly survived, no further detail given, and the company calls on allied units already fielding «Овод» drones to add a tribute marking in his honor. Self-reported by the company's own channel, not independently verified — same evidentiary caution already applied to Filippov's own self-reported assassination-attempt claims (proekt_arhangel#382/#739, s5475) — but taken together, a second named figure in this same producer network reporting a targeted-attack claim within the same investigation is a pattern worth tracking. ООО «Воздушный тракт» not yet promoted to a full entities.json record (no ИНН/ОГРН pulled yet) — a candidate for a future EGRUL search given it now has a named director and a documented incident, not just a product name.

PROCUREMENT-PLATFORM SWEEP, NEGATIVE RESULT (2026-09-04): checked zakupki.gov.ru's central EIS registry -- which aggregates every 44-ФЗ/223-ФЗ notice from all six accredited ЭТП (Сбербанк-АСТ, RTS-Tender, Roseltorg, Фабрикант, GZ Lot-Online, ТЭК-Торг) -- for every known Архангел-family legal entity, both as customer (заказчик) and as supplier (via scripts/zakupki_batch_pull.py's supplierTitle search): ooo-arkhangel (ИНН 9714079108), ano-arkhangel (ИНН 2315233718, Архангел Легион), ooo-arkhangel-zaporizhzhie (ИНН 9500026652), and ooo-arkhangel-tsentr (ИНН 5032379630). All four returned zero records across every procurement stage (Подача заявок/Работа комиссии/Закупка завершена). This is a genuine negative finding, not a coverage gap -- it confirms none of the Архангел-branded entities participate in formal state procurement in either direction, consistent with iStories' (s5484) reporting that Проект «Архангел» runs on direct patron financing/donation rather than government contracts -- a real structural contrast with гагаринг/Ушкуйник, both deeply embedded in госзакупки. Separately: this same sweep confirmed that individual 223-ФЗ procurement protocols (tested exhaustively on Ушкуйник's Центр коллективного пользования equipment-procurement notices) NEVER disclose winning-supplier identity in the public EIS record -- true even for single-bidder (несостоявшийся) lots, on both Sberbank-AST's own site and zakupki.gov.ru's protocol pages -- a structural disclosure gap in Russia's 223-ФЗ regime, not a login-wall to defeat. The one known supplier identity (Степанов Д.А., see people.json) was only recoverable because a human-readable free-text scanned protocol PDF happened to be archived separately.

His own EGRUL выписка (s7345) shows this is a real, long-established (registered 17.04.1997, pre-2002 formation) legal entity carrying a genuine electronics-manufacturing OKVED stack (26.51.2 primary — same radar/radionavigation code as АО «НПП «Радар ММС»» elsewhere in this registry — plus PCB/integrated-circuit/electronic-component manufacturing codes). Its sole shareholder (100%, acquired 13.02.2025) is ООО «Группа компаний «Аэромакс»» (ИНН 7710974353) — a corporate acquisition by the already-known Аэромакс group, not an unrelated company, and Бессонов was installed as its GD six days later (19.02.2026). No EGRUL restriction/недостоверность flags found. **Correction 2026-09-08 (same day), after pulling and reading all 5 available БФО filings (FY2021–2025, s7346–s7350, via bo.nalog.gov.ru — see [[bo_nalog_gov_ru_bfo_download_uncaptchad]]): despite the manufacturing OKVED, this is NOT an operating manufacturer.** Fixed assets have been near-zero and shrinking every year on file (₽2.409m in FY2021 down to ₽16,000 by FY2025); inventory (Запасы, line 1210) is zero in every filing; actual product/goods/services sales revenue (cash-flow line 4111) was ₽1.08m in FY2021 and ₽359k in FY2020 — trivial, and no later filing even shows a comparable line, consistent with the business having gone effectively dormant. The company instead carries large financial-instrument positions (loans issued ~₽206–255m, "приобретенные права в рамках оказания финансовых услуг" ~₽31.6m) and has posted enormous non-operating losses since FY2023: -₽48.6m (FY2023), -₽5.53bn (FY2024), -₽8.04bn (FY2025) net loss (Тыс. руб. units confirmed on the filing's own cover page), driven almost entirely by "Отчисления в оценочные резервы" (provisioning/write-down charges) inside "Прочие расходы", not by any operating cost of sales (Себестоимость продаж, line 2120, is literally 0 in the FY2025 filing). Read this as a dormant, financially-engineered shell that happens to hold a decades-old radar-manufacturing OKVED and legal-entity age — not evidence of actual production capacity — until/unless a future filing or other primary source shows real manufacturing activity resuming under Аэромакс's ownership. The Аэромакс-acquisition and Бессонов-directorship facts stand as originally found; only the "real manufacturing substance" characterization is withdrawn. **Name-collision check (2026-09-08):** ИНН 7713133550 is NOT the well-known Ростех/АФК «Система»-adjacent «Концерн «РТИ Системы»» group — that concern's holding entities are separate legal persons, АО «РТИ» (ИНН 5031005664, Ногинск) and АО «УК РТИ» (ИНН 7714847772), confirmed via a bo.nalog.gov.ru name search; no ownership or address link found between either of those and АО «РТИ-Радио». Treat the shared «РТИ» brand prefix as coincidental/reused branding, not a tie to the larger concern, unless a primary source says otherwise. Subsidiaries: none — its own EGRUL выписка (s7345) carries no «Сведения об участии в юридических лицах» section, i.e. it does not itself hold stakes in other companies.

marketing_claims.text_ru: 400 + апробированных на передовой разработок российского ОПК и “народного ВПК”
marketing_claims.text_en: 400+ developments of the Russian defence industry and the "people's military-industrial complex" tested at the front.
marketing_claims.context: 'Результаты работы Центра за 2025 год' block on the home page. Same «народный ВПК» framing Проект «Архангел» uses since 2023.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Серийное производство сотен единиц средств радиоэлектронной борьбы и связи
marketing_claims.text_en: Serial production of hundreds of electronic-warfare and communications units.
marketing_claims.context: Same results block on the home page; the unit claims its own production, not only testing. No maker is named on the page.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Около 350 единиц уничтоженного вооружения и военной техники, а также группы пехоты противника
marketing_claims.text_en: About 350 units of destroyed enemy weapons and military equipment, plus infantry groups.
marketing_claims.context: 2025 results block on the home page, alongside 'более 1000 бойцов' and 'Свыше 100 сбитых разведывательных и ударных беспилотных самолетов противника'. Unit's own claim, not independently confirmed.

marketing_claims.text_ru: от 210 000 рублей
marketing_claims.text_en: From 210,000 roubles a month.
marketing_claims.context: Monthly pay advertised on the home page; the FAQ (s7683) grounds it in art. 13.2 of Federal Law 76-FZ and a one-year contract. On 27.09.2024 the channel gave the figure as 'от 205 000 рублей' plus a one-off 500 000 рублей payment after the first stage (s7692).

marketing_claims.text_ru: Она составит 500 000 рублей.
marketing_claims.text_en: It will be 500,000 roubles.
marketing_claims.context: @russian_shock_volunteer_brigade msg 1618 (27.09.2024): one-off payment to those who sign the contract, paid after the first service stage.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Совместно с проектом Архангел и Батальоном Сармат(Рогозина Д.О.), прорабатыватся методика и техническое оснащение совместного проекта по защите объектов критически важной инфарструктуры.
marketing_claims.text_en: Together with Проект Архангел and the Sarmat battalion (Rogozin D.O.), a methodology and technical equipment for a joint project protecting critically important infrastructure are being worked out.
marketing_claims.context: @russian_shock_volunteer_brigade msg 1668 (18.10.2024), announcement by the centre «ЗОВ-АА»; invites manufacturers to 'апробация изделия', one event 'при поддержке Правительства Республики Татарстан в феврале 2025г.'

marketing_claims.text_ru: Близкие проекту "Архангел" волонтёрские инженерные сообщества и учебные центры БпЛА начинают тесное взаимодействие с нашим добровольческим военно-техническим отрядом "БАРС-САРМАТ".
marketing_claims.text_en: Volunteer engineering communities and UAV training centres close to the Arkhangel project are starting close cooperation with our volunteer military-technical detachment BARS-SARMAT.
marketing_claims.context: @russian_shock_volunteer_brigade msg 1683 (21.10.2024), first-person post ('нашим ... отрядом'); the unit's own channel names Архангел's network as an intended feeder.

marketing_claims.text_ru: при поддержке "БАРС-Сармат" провели испытания изделия народного ОПК - "Горыныч 2.0".
marketing_claims.text_en: with the support of BARS-Sarmat, tested the people's-defence-industry product Gorynych 2.0.
marketing_claims.context: Post carrying Архангел's sign-off (26.11.2024), listing uses including 'Поражение беспилотников со связью Старлинк или с оптоволоконным кабелем путем деформации стеклопластиковых и др. элементов конструкции' and 'Плановый поджог ... объектов'; 'Серийное производство доступно уже сейчас!'; supplies routed to '@KPOT1BOT'. Maker not named in the post.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Индивидуальный РЭБ " ЩИТ - И " прошел совместную апробацию с Б.А.Р.С - Сармат и Проектом Архангел.
marketing_claims.text_en: The individual EW set SHCHIT-I passed joint approbation with B.A.R.S-Sarmat and Project Arkhangel.
marketing_claims.context: @russian_shock_volunteer_brigade msg 1988 (15.01.2025): five-item kit covering 97 to 1020 MHz, suppression 'зафиксировано на расстоянии 310 метров', first kit to be handed to a named-later general at the front. Links to a TASS article; maker not named.

marketing_claims.text_ru: Особый интерес вызвал раздел по новым технологиям «Гермеса» в управлении роботами и группами роботов через Интернет.
marketing_claims.text_en: Particular interest was drawn by the section on Germes's new technologies for controlling robots and groups of robots over the Internet.
marketing_claims.context: Post of 16.02.2025 (Germes-side text, carried on the Sarmat channel): Germes trained БАРС САРМАТ instructors in soldering, frequency setting and ППРЧ, and gave the unit new interference-resistant comms kits and an 8-metre mast. Hashtags #сармат #барс #Рогозин.

open_questions.text: The extract prints no former name. The name entry carries ГРН 2247711610640 of 19.11.2024, 17 months before the EU listing, while the EU and Swiss entries use «Гаскар Групп». When the company was named «Гаскар Групп», and whether the lists used a name no longer in the register, is not established; an extract with the full record history, or the charter of 2022 or 2024, would show it.

The listing describes UAV development and production. The registered activities in the extract are 62.01 (primary), construction, consulting and R&D 72.19, with no manufacturing code. Which registered entity holds the drone line (ooo-gaskar, ooo-gaskar-integratsiya, ooo-gaskar-tekhnologii) is not established.

Participant Саитов Ренат Фаритович (ИНН 027503961630, 20% from 07.07.2026) shares a name with the 2019 general director of ООО «Гаскар Интеграция» in this registry (saitov-renat-faritovich, s1548). The company is not subject to mandatory audit and the filing is unaudited. The step is two orders of magnitude in one year, in the year before the EU listing of 23.04.2026. What the revenue was for is not stated in the filing; the registered activity is ОКВЭД-only and the production mismatch is already an open question. Not read: the notes, the counterparties, the source of the ₽64.1m other expenses.

The FY2025 filing is signed by «руководитель» Часовских Павел Анатольевич, not by Мингалимов Ленар Нуриахметович, who is the general director per the ЕГРЮЛ extract (entries of 18.05.2026 and 16.06.2026).
